Title: Easy way to find which card texts/icons have changed?

Messages.Author: paladin_brand
Messages.Body:
I've been mulling this over: is there an easy way to figure out what
card text / icons have changed across versions?

I know that updated text is marked in the White Wolf VTES card list,
but that's not quite the same thing as knowing what changed. For
example, if a card like Concealed Weapon once required Obfuscate (did
it? I seem to recall that it did), but no longer does, that fact is not
represented in the text list... the requirement is simply gone from the
list. I'm wondering if there's a way to determine the list of deltas,
as opposed to the list of current cards.

Why do I care? I'm considering making a series of stickers for myself
that I can affix to my older cards that update them to the most recent
version... but I'm not sure how to determine which cards I need to be
concerned with.

Any thoughts?

-Jason

To my knowledge, the only icons that have changed are the
Lasombra/Pander/Tzimisce Clan Icons (and an incredibly subtle change to
the Antitribu icons) from Sabbat and the new blood/pool icons from
Camarilla.

change from "first printing" (isn't that obvious?) to "contains correct
text".
